description: A brand answered a pitch with no, not interested, or asked not to be written to: marks it do_not_contact so it is never pitched again, and closes its unanswered pitches as lost. Do this for every reply like that, without asking first. Only the creator, in the app, can take a brand off the do-not-contact list.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: pitch_opt_out
title: Stop pitching a brand
